verdict.rationale: OpenHands documents a public OpenAPI spec (openapi.json), an Agent Server exposing HTTP/WebSocket API, a Software Agent SDK for programmatic control, and pricing tiers explicitly listing 'API support for automation and scripting' — together these constitute a documented public API for driving the product. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the API in production use and more detail on authentication/rate limits for the public API.
